title: All Horizons 90s MagicFit Promo
source_claim: 11 MagicFit-rendered Horizon scene clips rebuilt with cleaner spoken narration

scene_narration.caption: The table is alive, but the tools are fighting the table.
scene_narration.narration: The table is alive, but the tools are fighting it. Chummer6 turns that chaos into one campaign operating surface.

scene_narration.caption: NEXUS-PAN keeps shared state steady across devices.
scene_narration.narration: NEXUS-PAN keeps shared state steady when devices drift, drop, and return mid-session.

scene_narration.caption: ALICE explains build tradeoffs before they break play.
scene_narration.narration: ALICE compares builds, catches role traps, and explains tradeoffs with receipts before play starts.

scene_narration.caption: KARMA FORGE makes house rules governed and reversible.
scene_narration.narration: KARMA FORGE turns house rules into governed packages with impact, history, and rollback.

scene_narration.caption: JACKPOINT turns table memory into sharp briefings.
scene_narration.narration: JACKPOINT turns what happened at the table into briefings, dossiers, and recaps players actually want to read.

scene_narration.caption: RUNSITE makes mission spaces legible before danger starts.
scene_narration.narration: RUNSITE makes mission spaces explorable and legible before the action starts.

scene_narration.caption: RUNBOOK PRESS turns campaign material into books.
scene_narration.narration: RUNBOOK PRESS turns campaign material into primers, guides, modules, and season books the table can carry forward.

scene_narration.caption: TABLE PULSE turns heat into bounded GM-approved reactions.
scene_narration.narration: TABLE PULSE turns live heat into bounded reactions, remote choices, and GM-approved fallout.

scene_narration.caption: BLACK LEDGER makes the city remember consequences.
scene_narration.narration: BLACK LEDGER makes the city remember: factions, heat, missions, newsreels, and consequences.

scene_narration.caption: COMMUNITY HUB helps players find runs and close the loop.
scene_narration.narration: COMMUNITY HUB helps players find runs, pass preflight, get scheduled, and feed outcomes back into the world.

scene_narration.caption: All Horizons return to one table and one campaign.
scene_narration.narration: All Horizons point back to the same table: build the runner, run the scene, shape the world, and make the next session easier to start.
